blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createCompleteReturnValidationStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that a return can be created and completed for an order.
If the order is canceled, the items do not exist in the order,
the return reasons are invalid, or the refund amount is greater than the order total,
the step will throw an error.

You can retrieve an order details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

children.name: input
children.description: The data to create a return.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order to return items from.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the customer that's creating the return

children.name: return_shipping
children.description: The shipping details of the returned items.

children.name: receive_now
children.description: Whether to mark the return as received immediately.

children.name: refund_amount
children.description: The amount to refund the customer.

children.name: location_id
children.description:
The ID of the location to return the items to.
If not provided, the return shipping option's location
is used.
